exposure: levels of 18 different immune mediators (e.g., IL-10, IFN-g, TNF-a, CCL4, CXCL10, CCL13, CXCL8) in nasal epithelial lining fluid during viral episodes
outcome: airway immune mediator profile (upregulation/downregulation of specific immune mediators) during viral respiratory illnesses
cohort: The study included 277 children aged 0-3 years from the COPSAC2010 mother-child cohort, experiencing 493 episodes of acute respiratory illnesses.
finding: Children who developed asthma by age 6 years exhibited decreased levels of IL-10 during viral respiratory episodes compared to children who did not develop asthma.
